title: Operator-reason guidance needs the ownership resolver to land first

work_item.title: Every role's contract and live persona says how to name the operator's closed-list reason, so a finding that truly needs him opens with it and reaches him

outcome: Evidence of a missing implementation prerequisite; the requested role guidance and tests are not delivered.

prerequisite.title: One ownership registry and resolver: every waiting entry's owner, remedy, and capability come from one table that every surface projects
prerequisite.record_source: .beads/issues.jsonl, copied by the harness when this worktree was created; no live tracker query was made
prerequisite.release_condition: Land the ownership registry and resolver, then run the role-guidance item in a worktree containing that implementation. Read its accepted reasons and actual finding and escalation input fields before writing the guidance and tests.

source_evidence.observation: This package does not exist at the recorded revision. The resolver's closed set and prefix parser cannot be imported or exercised here.
The existing derivation creates operator actions from a handling with NeedsOperator set or from an unhandled critical report. It does not parse a closed-list reason followed by a colon.
The existing function assigns MoverOperator directly. It does not call an ownership resolver.
The existing fixture uses a handling reason without a closed-list prefix and expects it on NeedsHuman. This is source evidence of the earlier routing contract, not an execution result.

The design assigns the closed set to internal/ownership and lists fundamental-intent, credential, forge-setting, beyond-grant, human-gate, own-hold, and diverged-history. The design is present; its implementing package is absent.

acceptance_status.contracts_and_personas: Unchanged. Teaching prefix-based routing before that routing exists would describe behavior this revision does not provide.
acceptance_status.reason_drift_test: Not implemented. Comparing guidance with a new local copy of the design's list would not compare it with the reasons the resolver accepts.
acceptance_status.report_routing_test: Not implemented. The requested distinction between a listed prefix and no prefix depends on the absent resolver. Reimplementing report ownership here would duplicate the prerequisite's work and violate the shared-resolver boundary.

scope: This diagnosis is the only change. No contracts, personas, production code, tests, configuration, governed artifacts, or tracker export were changed.
